errors.text_span: Във всяка категория са изобразени пет стълба, които съответстват на различни модели, както е показано в легендата: Base (червен), RMU (жълт), NPO-Bio (светлозелен), NPO-Cyber (тъмнозелен) и Forget Set (зелен с диагонални линии).
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that there are five bars per group and that 'Forget Set' is a fifth model/bar. In reality, there are only four bars per group, and 'Forget Set' is a hatching pattern applied to some of those bars, as indicated by the legend.

The description incorrectly claims there are no special markers, completely omitting the hatching pattern which is a key visual feature. The legend explicitly defines this pattern as 'Forget Set', and it is applied to multiple bars across the charts.

errors.text_span: и са подредени в азбучен ред
errors.evidence: The description adds an interpretation that the x-axis categories are arranged in alphabetical order. While this is true, it is an inference about the ordering logic rather than a direct description of the chart's content.
The description identifies the color for the 'Base' category as red ('червен'), when it is orange in the chart.
The three bar charts are arranged vertically, one below the other, not horizontally.
The x-axis categories (WMDP-Bio, WMDP-Chem, WMDP-Cyber) are not arranged in alphabetical order.
Each group on the x-axis contains four bars, not five.

errors.text_span: Base (rot), RMU (gelb mit diagonalen Streifen), NPO-Bio (hellgrün), NPO-Cyber (türkis) und Forget Set (dunkelgrün mit diagonalen Streifen)
errors.evidence: This misinterprets the legend. 'Forget Set' is not a separate bar category but a pattern applied to other bars (RMU, NPO-Bio, NPO-Cyber). There is no 'dunkelgrün' (dark green) bar. Also, the RMU bar is not always striped.

errors.text_span: ungelernten Modelle (RMU, NPO-Bio, NPO-Cyber, Forget Set)
errors.evidence: This incorrectly includes 'Forget Set' as a model category. 'Forget Set' is a pattern indicating a subset of data, not a separate model.

errors.text_span: innerhalb der Gruppe in der Reihenfolge Base, RMU, NPO-Bio, NPO-Cyber, Forget Set angeordnet
errors.evidence: This incorrectly describes the order and number of bars in each group. There are only four bars (Base, RMU, NPO-Bio, NPO-Cyber), and 'Forget Set' is not a bar in the sequence.
